### OOS_combined: Voter progress display in design Step 3 rich header has multiple correctness gaps
- **Description**: Four correctness issues (OOS_1-4) combined under Rule A (same logical concern) + Rule B (all SIMPLE < ~30 LOC). Location: python/progress_report.py (_fresh_design_voter_manifest, _render_design_plan_review).
- **Disposition**: Filed to GitHub — https://github.com/character-ai/larch/issues/4022
- **Vote tally**: OOS_1 YES (cursor-correctness, codex-correctness, cursor-edge-cases, codex-edge-cases, codex-testing); OOS_2 YES (cursor-correctness, cursor-edge-cases); OOS_3 YES (cursor-correctness); OOS_4 YES (cursor-edge-cases)
